title: billing-reconciler: architecture overview
body:
# billing-reconciler: architecture overview

The service imports Meta's daily pricing export, normalises it into billable lines and matches them against wallet debits. Mismatches are written to `recon_mismatches` and surfaced on the recon dashboard.

Components: importer, matcher, mismatch writer, `recon-cli` for operators.

title: Runbook: Nightly wallet settlement (wallet-settlement)
body:
# Runbook: Nightly wallet settlement

Owner: Rahul Verma. Last reviewed 3 Feb 2026.

## Schedule
wallet-settlement runs nightly at 00:00 IST from the `settlement-nightly` cron and normally finishes in 25 to 40 minutes.

## Inputs
- Meta pricing analytics export for the previous day.
- wallet-ledger day-close snapshot.

## If the job fails
1. Check the Better Stack alert for the failing run id.
2. Re-run: `wallet-settlement run --date <YYYY-MM-DD>`.
3. Confirm invoices on the billing dashboard.
4. If it fails twice, page the Messaging on-call.

## Contacts
Escalation: Rahul Verma.

title: messaging-api: idempotency keys
body:
# messaging-api: idempotency keys

Clients send an `Idempotency-Key` header on POST /messages. Keys and the original response live in Redis with a 72-hour TTL. A repeated key returns the stored response with status 200 and header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

title: Finance reporting models

# Finance reporting models

Message revenue is recognised when Meta bills the conversation, not at wallet top-up (since April 2026 close). Unspent top-ups are reported as wallet liability. Models: `finance_snapshot`, `revenue_monthly`, `wallet_liability_daily`.

title: RFC-014: Billing reconciliation matching strategy
body:
# RFC-014: Billing reconciliation matching strategy

Status: Accepted (20 May 2026). Author: Rahul Verma. Reviewer: Arjun Nair.

## Problem
Exact amount matching between Meta's pricing export and wallet debits flags about 2% of FX-converted debits as mismatches every night.

## Decision
Match on Meta's message ID (wamid) first. Then match on amount with a tolerance of ±0.01 USD, for FX-converted debits only.

## Why
Meta bills in USD and rounds conversions half-up. Wallets debit in INR and the ledger uses banker's rounding (half-even). The two disagree by at most one cent. Widening the tolerance for everything would hide real errors, so it applies to FX debits only.

## Rollout
Shipped in billing-reconciler behind `match_v2`, enabled 28 May.

title: api-gateway: Idempotency-Key enforcement
body:
# api-gateway: Idempotency-Key enforcement

The gateway enforces `Idempotency-Key` on POST /messages using the shared messaging keystore (72h TTL). Duplicates get a 409 with the original response. Plugin owner: Ritu Bansal.

title: RFC-019: wallet-ledger transactional outbox
body:
# RFC-019: wallet-ledger transactional outbox

Status: Accepted. Tracking: CHEER-2412.

wallet-ledger writes events to an `outbox` table in the same transaction as the ledger entry. A relay publishes them with at-least-once delivery, keyed by event id. This removes the event loss during deploys that causes phantom reconciliation mismatches.

title: Runbook: billing-reconciler
body:
# Runbook: billing-reconciler

Matches Meta's daily pricing records against wallet debits for every workspace.

## Common issues
- When it is flagging a spike of mismatches this morning: usually Meta's pricing export landing late; the importer retries every 15 minutes. Fix: re-run the matcher for that date once the import is green.
- When it is slow on the morning run: usually the matcher starting before the import had finished. Fix: wait for the 07:30 retry, it clears itself.
- When it is showing duplicate mismatches for one workspace: usually a refund for failed messages that hasn't posted yet. Fix: mark them as timing mismatches; they auto-close on the next run.
- When it is stuck on the pricing import step: usually an expired Meta system-user token on the importer. Fix: rotate the token in Vault and re-run the import.

title: wallet-settlement: design notes
body:
# wallet-settlement: design notes

Nightly job that settles workspace wallets against the day's usage and raises GST invoices.

## Common issues
- When it is running long tonight: usually a huge festive-sale day, run time scales with message count. Fix: let it finish; it parallelises per workspace after the first 10 minutes.
- When it is showing fewer invoices than expected: usually a workspace flagged on credit hold. Fix: check `credit_holds` and release the hold with Finance approval.
- When it is skipping one workspace: usually the day's usage snapshot arriving late. Fix: look at the run summary in Grafana before touching anything.

title: kairo-erp-bridge: design notes
body:
# kairo-erp-bridge: design notes

Pulls Kairo Living's nightly order files over SFTP and verifies their order-event webhooks.

## Common issues
- When it is timing out on the morning pull: usually the remote host rotating its key. Fix: update the known_hosts entry from the bridge config repo.
- When it is rejecting a webhook signature: usually clock skew on the webhook timestamp. Fix: check the timestamp tolerance; it's 5 minutes.
- When it is pulling the same order file twice: usually the done-marker file not being written on their side. Fix: the bridge dedupes by checksum, so the second pull is harmless.

title: messaging-api: FAQ
body:
# messaging-api: FAQ

Public API for sending WhatsApp template and session messages, with delivery webhooks.

## Common issues
- When it is returning 409s on template sends: usually a client reusing keys across different payloads. Fix: return the stored response and tell the client to generate a fresh key.
- When it is slow on bulk sends since the last deploy: usually a missing index on sends by workspace. Fix: the index migration is in the next release.
- When it is rejecting a client's idempotency header: usually a header with whitespace that the validator rejects. Fix: trim the header in the client SDK.
- When it is throwing 500s on media messages: usually media URLs that expire before Meta fetches them. Fix: ask them to host media for at least 10 minutes or upload it first.

title: Runbook: wallet-ledger
body:
# Runbook: wallet-ledger

Ledger of every wallet top-up, message debit and refund.

## Common issues
- When it is showing a balance mismatch alert: usually a refund posted on one side only. Fix: post the compensating entry through the admin tool, never by hand.
- When it is lagging on the event stream: usually a consumer stuck on a poison message. Fix: skip the message with the DLQ tool and file a ticket.
- When it is rejecting a refund entry: usually a currency without a configured wallet account. Fix: add the account mapping and replay the entry.

title: Runbook: api-gateway
body:
# Runbook: api-gateway

Kong-based edge gateway: API keys, rate limits, idempotency headers.

## Common issues
- When it is rate limiting a workspace too aggressively: usually the workspace sharing an API key across environments. Fix: give them a separate sandbox key.
- When it is adding latency on auth: usually the JWKS cache expiring at the same time on every pod. Fix: the jitter on the JWKS refresh fixes it.
- When it is returning 502s for one route: usually an upstream health check pointing at the wrong port. Fix: fix the upstream target in the declarative config.

title: workflow-engine: design notes
body:
# workflow-engine: design notes

Runs customer workflows: Shopify triggers, abandoned-cart and COD flows, AI assistant hand-offs.

## Common issues
- When it is firing the abandoned-cart message after the order was placed: usually the Shopify order webhook arriving after the cart timer. Fix: check the order lookup before the cart timer fires.
- When it is skipping the COD confirmation node: usually a draft order with no payment gateway set. Fix: skip draft orders in the COD trigger.
- When it is double-sending a welcome message: usually a retry on a node that already succeeded. Fix: make the send node idempotent on the run id.

title: ci-pipeline: design notes
body:
# ci-pipeline: design notes

Self-hosted GitHub Actions runners and the deploy pipeline.

## Common issues
- When it is queueing builds for ages: usually all runners busy with nightly jobs. Fix: bump the runner pool for the day in the autoscaler.
- When it is failing on the docker login step: usually an expired registry token on the runners. Fix: rotate the registry token in the runner secrets.
- When it is running the wrong workflow for a branch: usually a stale workflow file from a renamed branch. Fix: re-push the workflow from the branch.

title: Runbook: voice-gateway
body:
# Runbook: voice-gateway

SIP bridge and media pipeline behind Voice AI calls and voice campaigns.

## Common issues
- When it is dropping calls after 30 seconds: usually the carrier's session timer not being refreshed. Fix: send a re-INVITE before the session timer runs out.
- When it is sounding robotic on outbound calls: usually audio being downsampled to 8 kHz on the trunk. Fix: force the wideband codec on the trunk profile.
- When it is only triggering a third of a voice campaign: usually the per-second call limit on the carrier account. Fix: pace the campaign under the carrier's calls-per-second limit.

# Release notes: September 2026

- **Carousel templates via messaging-api** (v3.14, 8 Sep): send product carousels of up to 10 cards from the API. Shopify product variables work in every card. Docs: /docs/api/carousel-templates.
- **Workflows: wait-for-reply node** (15 Sep): pause a workflow until the customer answers, with a timeout branch.

title: Product FAQ for CS (Q4 2026)
author: p-arnav
body:
# Product FAQ for CS (Q4 2026)

**Is SSO available?** Not yet. SSO (SAML) and SCIM provisioning are planned for Q1 2027; they moved from December after IdP testing. Don't commit to December. Say Q1 and offer to confirm the timeline in writing. Owner: Isha Chawla.

**Can customers send carousel templates from the API?** Yes, since messaging-api v3.14 (8 Sep). Docs: /docs/api/carousel-templates.

**Large campaign report exports fail.** Known issue CHEER-2547 for broadcasts over 50k recipients. Workaround: export one day of sends at a time. Owner: Dev Malhotra.

**How many transfer numbers can a voice agent have?** One today. Multiple transfer numbers are planned for December (RM-104).

**Can the AI assistant reply in Hindi?** Hindi and Hinglish replies are in progress for mid-November (RM-109).

**Is there Instagram DM automation?** In beta, generally available at the end of November (RM-102).

title: Battlecard: price objections vs cheaper WhatsApp tools
author: p-kabir
body:
# Battlecard: price objections vs cheaper WhatsApp tools

From the deals we won this year:
1. Show attributed revenue before talking price. Cart and COD flows usually recover 8–12% of abandoned carts; put the rupee number on screen.
2. Don't discount the plan. Bundle AI assistant credits for two months instead.
3. Point at delivery support: a named CSM and weekend on-call, with RCAs for every incident.
4. If they compare per-message prices, compare per-conversation cost including failed sends and refunds.

title: Save playbook: champion left and a product issue
author: p-arnav
body:
# Save playbook: champion left and a product issue

What worked on the accounts we saved this year:
1. Exec sponsor call within 7 days, run by the CSM with the Head of CS.
2. A fix date from the bug owner, in writing, before the call.
3. Admin re-onboarding for the successor (60 minutes, their own data).
4. Service credit for the weeks the issue blocked them, approved by Finance.

When a promised feature slips: tell the customer before they ask, give the new quarter rather than a date you can't hold, and confirm it in writing.

title: Pricing and plans (2026)
author: p-naina
body:
# Pricing and plans (2026)

Plans: Startup, Growth, Pro and Enterprise, billed monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually. Prices are ex-GST (18%).
Agent seats: ₹1,500 per user per month on Pro. Message credits are prepaid into the wallet and billed at Meta's rate plus our margin.
Pro includes AI assistant credits; Enterprise adds SSO (when available), a named CSM and custom integrations.

title: Renewal process
author: p-arnav
body:
# Renewal process

CS owns renewals. The window opens 45 days before plan end for annual plans (30 days for quarterly).
Stages: Not started, Follow-up sent, No response, In conversation, Meeting booked, Negotiating, Invoice raised, Payment pending, Renewed.
An account is Lapsed 30 days after plan end. Every promise made on a renewal call goes into the account notes the same day.
